name: 27217 · Burlington, NC
findings: ZIP 27217 (Burlington) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27217 (Burlington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27217 (Burlington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
